description: Narrative sections from the latest 10-K/10-Q as clean text — Risk Factors (item 1A), MD&A (item 7), Business (item 1), etc. — or from an IPO registration statement (form 'S-1'): risk_factors, use_of_proceeds, mda, business, principal_stockholders, shares_eligible. Built for LLM/RAG equity research. Omit 'item' to list the available sections first. For a company that hasn't listed yet, pass its CIK as 'ticker'.

form.description: Filing type: '10-K' (default), '10-Q', 'S-1' (latest S-1 or S-1/A) or 'S-1/A'.

item.description: Section to fetch, e.g. '1A' (Risk Factors) or '7' (MD&A) for a 10-K, or 'risk_factors' / 'use_of_proceeds' for an S-1. Omit to list available sections.

name: get_sections
title: Get 10-K/10-Q/S-1 narrative sections
